lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: You're tuned to Bubble Economy FM! Marina City Nine, where it's always Friday night. The weekend starts now!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Bubble Economy FM. Nineteen eighty six, forever. Your hair looks amazing.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: This is Bubble Economy FM, ninety point five five. Prices are up, the top is down, and the weekend starts... now!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Bubble Economy FM. A friendly reminder: please don't bring anything sharp to the waterfront.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Good morning, Marina City Nine! Just kidding. It's Friday night. It's always Friday night. Bubble Economy FM!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Bubble Economy FM. The sound of a city that has never, ever had a Monday.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Bubble Economy FM. It's late, it's Friday, and the neon is doing that thing you like.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Kiko Starlight here, with some big news. Are you ready? The weekend... starts... now!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: I've said that every night for forty years, and I have been right every single time. That's fourteen thousand six hundred Fridays in a row. Here's a song for the next one!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Quick look at the markets! The Marina Index is up again, just like every day since nineteen eighty six. Analysts say the bubble is completely healthy.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Analysts are holding the bubble very, very carefully, with both hands, and asking everybody to stop walking near it. Here's a song!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: A reminder from the city council! This weekend is the Marina City pin amnesty. Bring your pins, your needles, your cactuses and your pointed remarks to the drop-off on Harbour Drive. No questions asked.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Let's keep this bubble beautiful! Kiko loves you.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Property update! A studio apartment in the Bay Tower now costs one sunset, two lifetimes of savings, and a sincere compliment to the landlord.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: They're selling fast! The landlord has never felt so good about himself. Here's the next one.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: A listener writes in. Kiko, what's a Monday? Oh, honey. I don't know. Nobody here has seen one since nineteen eighty six.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: My mother says she saw a Monday once, when she was a little girl. She says it was grey, and it had a meeting in it. Let's not talk about it. Here's a song!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Big shout-out to everybody at the Golden Tower offices! You got your bonus today! You get your bonus every day, because every day is Friday, and Friday is payday!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Put it in the bank. The bank will put it in a bigger bank. Everybody wins! The weekend starts now!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: This one goes out to the man on the forty-second floor who has been taping this station since nineteen eighty six. He's on tape number fourteen thousand.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: He has labelled every single one of them, Friday. And he is not wrong!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: It's getting late, Marina City. The neon's soft, the bay is shiny, and somewhere a saxophone is thinking about you.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Is the weekend still starting? Of course it is, baby. It's just starting... slowly.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Shout-out to the night operator up on that relay ship! You look like you've been working so hard. Well, guess what? On our frequency, it's Friday.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Clock off. Loosen the tie. The weekend starts now.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: If it's daytime where you are, don't panic! Close the blinds, push your jacket sleeves up, and put a slice of pineapple on the rim of something. Congratulations. It's Friday night.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Lisa Lagoon does this every day. She has never seen the sun, and she has never looked better.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: People ask me, Kiko, aren't you tired? Forty years of Friday nights? And I tell them, no! Every Friday is the first Friday!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Also, yes. I'm a little tired. But in a sparkly way. Here's a song!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Tonight at the Lagoon Lounge it's karaoke, and the Overtime Boys are doing their duet again. They've been doing that duet since nineteen eighty six.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: They have never once finished it, because somebody always shouts, one more time! And honestly? That somebody is usually me.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Bubble Economy FM, and this is Friday Night Drive! Hands on the wheel, the bay on your left, and the weekend starts... now!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: The Bay Expressway tonight is one long ribbon of tail lights, and every single one of them is singing along.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: If you're stuck in traffic, that's not traffic. That's a parade. And you're in it!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Drive safe out there, Marina City. Mirrors, signal, shoulder pads.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: And if you see the man in the white convertible who's been circling the bay since nineteen eighty six, give him a wave. He's looking for the exit. There isn't one. He's having a wonderful time.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: This is After Hours Marina, on Bubble Economy FM. The last train left an hour ago. Another last train leaves in an hour. Let's take it slow.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: It's three in the morning, and the vending machines on Pier Five are glowing for nobody. That's the most romantic thing I know.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Here's a slow one, for the vending machines.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: The waiter at the Lagoon Lounge is stacking the chairs. In an hour, he'll unstack them again.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: That's the economy, honey. That's what keeps it bubbling.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Good morn... no. No. This is Saturday Never Comes, on Bubble Economy FM. Blinds down, sunglasses on. It's still Friday night, baby.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Some of you out there may have a Saturday morning. That's okay! We don't judge.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Just keep it down, would you? People here are very sensitive about it.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: A listener in the Harbour District says she woke up today, and for one second, she felt like it was Saturday.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Honey, that's just what happens when you sleep in your earrings. Put the jacket back on. Drink some water. It's Friday.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Is it Halloween? Not here, honey. Here it's Friday. But it's your Halloween, so the whole city has dressed up, just for you.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: The costume is Saturday. Everybody's walking round in pyjamas, reading a newspaper. It's terrifying. The weekend starts now!

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Spooky story time. A temp in the old office district swears he found a calendar in a drawer, and on it there was a page that said...

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Monday.

lines.speaker: Kiko Starlight
lines.text: Police went in. They found nothing. Just a stapler, still warm. Stay out of the old office district, Marina City. Here's a song, with all the lights on.
